_comment: GROUND TRUTH, ENTERED BY A PERSON, NOT BY A PARSER.
This file exists to catch the one silent failure mode of the whole corpus
design: an extractor bug that misreads BOTH sides identically turns a real
difference into a false match, and no amount of automation can catch it,
because the automation is what is wrong. Every value below was read off a
rendered image of the page -- deliberately not through the text layer and
not through pdf-lib, so that a shared bug in the reading path cannot reach
both this file and the extractor.
Do not regenerate this file with a script. If a value here is wrong, look
at the page again and fix it by hand.
verifiedFrom: 150 dpi page renders read visually, page by page

rentSchedule._file: 2026 - RCS/800010652 - Approved Rent Schedule - 12-29-25 - Lansing Manor (Village Green III) Fully Executed.pdf
_note: This is the APPROVED schedule as returned by the contract administrator,
which is the closest thing the corpus has to 'what the draft should have
said'. Its page 1 is a MAM transmittal letter; the HUD-92458 is page 2.
The transmittal names the property 'Lansing Manor (Village Green III)'
while the form itself says only 'Lansing Manor' -- the alias case the

observations: The study's concluded market rents ($1,190 and $1,200) are adopted verbatim as the approved contract rents. The RCS was accepted in full, so a correct app should reproduce these exactly.

Unit type names are RENAMED between documents: the study says '1BR/1BA without patio' and '1BR/1BA with patio'; every filed document says '1Bedroom'/'1Bedroom Patio' or '1-Bedroom'/'1-Bedroom Patio'. A comparison that expects the study's wording will show two false mismatches on every property that does this.

The utility allowance FELL from 116 to 99 across the cycle. It is not carried forward from the prior schedule and cannot be derived from the study either -- it comes from the UA Baseline analysis. Expect the app to have no source for it.

Part B grew between cycles: the year-0 schedule adds Patio, Vinyl Flooring, Business Center, Security, Emergency Pull Cord and Trash/Recycling, and drops Drapes. Part B is therefore NOT a straight carry-forward from the prior schedule.
The tenant notice is dated 10/06/2025, one day BEFORE the cover letter's 10/07/2025. If the app derives both from a single date, one of them will be wrong by a day.
Two different people at the contract administrator appear: Ken Callicutt receives the submission, Boolin Middleton signs the approval. Only the first is knowable when the package is generated.
